Cooling checks weekly rules
This section sets out one way of working

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: keep companion travel calm, clear, and consistent for crews and guests.

Staff should check pet details before acceptance, confirm carrier fit, and make sure health paperwork is complete. The desk keeps a gentle tone, shares plain instructions, and records any concern as soon as it appears. <<FACT F102>> If a case looks unusual, the team pauses the handoff, follows the normal review path, and keeps the traveler informed in simple language. When boarding is underway, staff stay nearby, watch for stress, and guide the handoff with care. <<FACT F093>> Pets should remain secure, labels should stay visible, and any change in condition should be noted right away.

If you need help with a live case, contact the duty supervisor or the operations desk for guidance.
